---
title: "Seurat preprocessing, CCA integration and annotation: method excerpts"
output: html_document
---

These excerpts are adapted from a supplied exploratory workflow used in my
analysis. Its source contains mixed analysis contexts, so attribution of this
entire notebook to one project is **not established**. It is presented as a
companion methods example, not as results for the human endothelial-cell study.
Input objects can include collaborator-provided data; using this workflow does
not imply sole authorship of the data or upstream processing.

The excerpts preserve substantive operations from the source while replacing
private paths, sample selections, marker panels, cluster labels and analysis
choices with local inputs. Repeated trial blocks are consolidated. This is not a
complete executable study pipeline and has not been rerun on the private data.
Every code chunk has `eval=FALSE`; no study outputs are embedded.

## Local prerequisites

Requires an Assay5-compatible Seurat release, dplyr, ggplot2 and Matrix.
zellkonverter is required for the H5AD alternative; scDblFinder, SingleR and
scuttle are only needed for their separate exploratory branches. Install any
required Leiden backend separately. The historical environment was not captured
in a lockfile. No Harmony operation appears in these source excerpts.

Local inputs, excluded from version control:

- `endothelial_object.rds`: a Seurat object with RNA counts and metadata.
- `method_settings.rds`: local settings for `annotation_column`, `subset_label`,
  `batch_column`, `group_column`, `excluded_batches`, `excluded_clusters`,
  `pc_candidates`, `selected_pc`, `integration_dims`, `k_weight`,
  `doublet_sample_column`, `doublet_label_column` and `singlet_label`.
- `review_features.txt`: one review gene per line; `annotation.tsv`: columns
  `cluster` and `label` containing a locally reviewed mapping.
- `reference_object.rds`: a species-appropriate annotated expression reference;
  `reference_labels.rds`: matching labels. The original reference calls are
  generalized to avoid implying a reference choice for a different study.

Keep all generated matrices, objects, metadata, labels, tables and plots private.

```{r local-setup, eval=FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(Matrix)
set.seed(1234)
settings <- readRDS("local_inputs/method_settings.rds")
ec <- readRDS("local_inputs/endothelial_object.rds")
review_features <- readLines("local_inputs/review_features.txt")
dir.create("private_outputs", showWarnings = FALSE)

DimPlot(ec, reduction = "umap", group.by = settings$batch_column)
DimPlot(ec, reduction = "umap", group.by = settings$group_column)
```

## Select cells, re-normalize and inspect PCA

The source repeatedly selected a population, removed selected clusters after
marker review, and re-normalized. The actual selections and reasons are not
public. The calls below show the mechanics without preserving those decisions.

```{r subset-and-normalize, eval=FALSE}
Idents(ec) <- settings$annotation_column
ec_subset <- subset(ec, idents = settings$subset_label)
Idents(ec_subset) <- "seurat_clusters"
if (length(settings$excluded_clusters) > 0) {
  ec_subset <- subset(ec_subset, idents = settings$excluded_clusters,
                       invert = TRUE)
}
ec_subset[["RNA"]]$data <- NULL
ec_subset[["RNA"]]$scale.data <- NULL
ec_subset <- NormalizeData(ec_subset)
ec_subset <- FindVariableFeatures(
  ec_subset, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 3000
)
ec_subset <- ScaleData(ec_subset)
ec_subset <- RunPCA(ec_subset, npcs = 100)
ElbowPlot(ec_subset, ndims = 50)
DimHeatmap(ec_subset, dims = 25:30, cells = 200, balanced = TRUE)
```

## Compare neighbor graphs, clusters and UMAPs across PC cutoffs

The source tested multiple cutoffs in separate objects; these repeated blocks
are expressed as a loop. Resolution and optional UMAP settings should be
reviewed for the local analysis, not interpreted as a validated model selection.

```{r pc-sensitivity, eval=FALSE}
pc_trials <- lapply(settings$pc_candidates, function(n_pc) {
  trial <- FindNeighbors(ec_subset, dims = seq_len(n_pc), verbose = FALSE)
  trial <- FindClusters(trial, resolution = 0.5, verbose = FALSE)
  trial <- RunUMAP(trial, dims = seq_len(n_pc), verbose = FALSE)
  list(object = trial,
       clusters = DimPlot(trial, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE),
       groups = DimPlot(trial, reduction = "umap",
                        group.by = settings$group_column))
})
names(pc_trials) <- as.character(settings$pc_candidates)
ec_subset <- pc_trials[[as.character(settings$selected_pc)]]$object
```

## Export counts and metadata for a separate Python analysis

The original workflow used a manual Matrix Market handoff and also included an
H5AD conversion via SingleCellExperiment. They are alternatives; no downstream
scVI training is performed by these R calls. Counts are genes by cells; metadata
row names preserve cell identifiers.

```{r matrix-handoff, eval=FALSE}
raw_counts <- ec_subset[["RNA"]]$counts
stopifnot(identical(colnames(raw_counts), rownames(ec_subset[[]])))
writeMM(raw_counts, file = "private_outputs/counts.mtx")
write.csv(ec_subset[[]], file = "private_outputs/metadata.csv")
write.csv(rownames(ec_subset), file = "private_outputs/genes.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r h5ad-alternative, eval=FALSE}
library(zellkonverter)
sce <- as.SingleCellExperiment(ec_subset)
writeH5AD(sce, file = "private_outputs/endothelial_object.h5ad")
```

## Separate branch: Seurat CCA integration

This branch starts from a local object and contrasts an unintegrated PCA graph
with a CCA-integrated graph. Batch exclusions, dimensionality and `k.weight`
were data-dependent choices in the source and are now local inputs. Ensure each
batch supports the requested dimensionality and integration settings.

```{r cca-preprocessing, eval=FALSE}
integration_object <- readRDS("local_inputs/endothelial_object.rds")
integration_object[["RNA"]]$data <- NULL
integration_object[["RNA"]]$scale.data <- NULL
Idents(integration_object) <- settings$batch_column
if (length(settings$excluded_batches) > 0) {
  integration_object <- subset(integration_object,
                               idents = settings$excluded_batches,
                               invert = TRUE)
}
integration_object[["RNA"]] <- split(
  integration_object[["RNA"]],
  f = integration_object[[]][[settings$batch_column]]
)
integration_object <- NormalizeData(integration_object)
integration_object <- FindVariableFeatures(integration_object)
integration_object <- ScaleData(integration_object)
integration_object <- RunPCA(integration_object)
ElbowPlot(integration_object, ndims = 50)
DimHeatmap(integration_object, dims = settings$integration_dims,
           cells = 200, reduction = "pca")

integration_object <- FindNeighbors(
  integration_object, dims = settings$integration_dims, reduction = "pca"
)
integration_object <- FindClusters(
  integration_object, resolution = 0.5, cluster.name = "unintegrated_clusters"
)
integration_object <- RunUMAP(
  integration_object, dims = settings$integration_dims, reduction = "pca",
  reduction.name = "umap.unintegrated"
)
DimPlot(integration_object, reduction = "umap.unintegrated",
        group.by = c(settings$group_column, "unintegrated_clusters"))
```

```{r cca-integration, eval=FALSE}
integration_object <- IntegrateLayers(
  object = integration_object, method = CCAIntegration,
  orig.reduction = "pca", new.reduction = "integrated.cca",
  dims = settings$integration_dims, k.weight = settings$k_weight,
  verbose = FALSE
)
integration_object[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(integration_object[["RNA"]])
integration_object <- FindNeighbors(
  integration_object, reduction = "integrated.cca",
  dims = settings$integration_dims
)
integration_object <- FindClusters(integration_object, resolution = 0.5)
integration_object <- RunUMAP(
  integration_object, reduction = "integrated.cca",
  dims = settings$integration_dims
)
DimPlot(integration_object, reduction = "umap",
        group.by = c(settings$batch_column, "seurat_clusters"))
```

## Marker review, local exclusions and annotation

The source reviewed feature, dot and heatmap plots before applying cluster
exclusions and annotations. This excerpt preserves the operations, not the
original marker panels or conclusions. Review precedes any local exclusion.

```{r marker-review, eval=FALSE}
FeaturePlot(ec_subset, features = review_features, cols = c("lightgrey", "red"))
DotPlot(ec_subset, features = review_features, cluster.idents = TRUE) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
FeaturePlot(ec_subset, features = c("nCount_RNA", "nFeature_RNA", "percent.mt"))
Idents(ec_subset) <- "seurat_clusters"
markers <- FindAllMarkers(ec_subset, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25)
write.table(markers, "private_outputs/cluster_markers.tsv",
            quote = FALSE, sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE)
top20 <- markers %>% group_by(cluster) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = avg_log2FC, n = 20, with_ties = TRUE)
DoHeatmap(ec_subset, features = unique(top20$gene))

annotation <- read.delim("local_inputs/annotation.tsv", colClasses = "character")
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(annotation$cluster))
stopifnot(setequal(annotation$cluster, levels(ec_subset)))
ec_subset <- RenameIdents(ec_subset, setNames(annotation$label, annotation$cluster))
ec_subset$reviewed_annotation <- Idents(ec_subset)
DimPlot(ec_subset, reduction = "umap", group.by = "reviewed_annotation")
VlnPlot(ec_subset, features = review_features, log = TRUE, pt.size = 0.1)
```

## Descriptive cell composition

This retains the source's pooled cell summaries. It does not implement
donor-level differential abundance testing.

```{r composition, eval=FALSE}
metadata <- ec_subset[[]]
metadata$analysis_group <- metadata[[settings$group_column]]
composition <- metadata %>%
  group_by(analysis_group, seurat_clusters) %>%
  summarise(Count = n(), .groups = "drop_last") %>%
  mutate(percent = Count / sum(Count) * 100) %>% ungroup()
ggplot(composition, aes(analysis_group, percent, fill = seurat_clusters)) +
  geom_col() + theme_classic()
cell_ratio <- as.data.frame(prop.table(
  table(metadata$seurat_clusters, metadata$analysis_group), margin = 2
))
ggplot(cell_ratio, aes(Var2, Freq)) + geom_col() +
  facet_wrap(~Var1, scales = "free_y")
```

## Separate exploratory branch: reference-based annotation

The source contained more than one reference annotation trial. A local,
species-appropriate reference is required here. Choosing a reference, its label
granularity, and its normalization needs requires review for the current data.

```{r reference-annotation, eval=FALSE}
library(SingleR)
library(scuttle)
reference <- readRDS("local_inputs/reference_object.rds")
reference_labels <- readRDS("local_inputs/reference_labels.rds")
# This normalization was used in one source reference branch. Apply only if
# the supplied reference has counts and lacks the needed normalized assay.
reference <- logNormCounts(reference)
reference_result <- SingleR(
  test = as.SingleCellExperiment(ec_subset), ref = reference,
  labels = reference_labels
)
ec_subset$reference_labels <- reference_result$labels
DimPlot(ec_subset, reduction = "umap", group.by = "reference_labels")
```

## Separate exploratory branch: doublet review

scDblFinder was actually invoked in the source. Its sample grouping is made
explicit and must identify appropriate capture samples; do not substitute a
pooled disease label without assessing that choice. The second block only
filters existing DoubletFinder classifications. The source does **not** contain
the DoubletFinder parameter sweep or model-fitting code.

```{r doublet-review, eval=FALSE}
library(scDblFinder)
doublet_input <- as.SingleCellExperiment(ec_subset)
doublet_result <- scDblFinder(
  doublet_input, samples = settings$doublet_sample_column, clusters = TRUE
)
ec_subset$scDblFinder_class <- as.character(doublet_result$scDblFinder.class)
DimPlot(ec_subset, reduction = "umap", group.by = "scDblFinder_class")
```

```{r existing-doubletfinder-labels, eval=FALSE}
labelled_object <- readRDS("local_inputs/endothelial_object.rds")
stopifnot(settings$doublet_label_column %in% colnames(labelled_object[[]]))
Idents(labelled_object) <- settings$doublet_label_column
singlets <- subset(labelled_object, idents = settings$singlet_label)
# The source then cleared normalized layers and repeated preprocessing.
singlets[["RNA"]]$data <- NULL
singlets[["RNA"]]$scale.data <- NULL
singlets <- NormalizeData(singlets)
singlets <- FindVariableFeatures(singlets, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)
singlets <- ScaleData(singlets)
singlets <- RunPCA(singlets, npcs = 100)
```

The source also referenced a saved SCTransform-processed object while explicitly
noting that its transformation code was missing. No SCTransform procedure is
reconstructed or claimed here. Abandoned conversion trials, unrelated legacy
branches and biological interpretation notes are excluded.
